name: Cartographer

feature.name: Dynamic Maps
feature.text: You can recall the geographic features of all places you've visited, and spend 10 minutes to sketch an accurate map of one of these locations — as long as you have cartographer's tools available.

text: Y ou are a master in the making and copying of maps, measuring and conveying the geography of various regions through your extensive studies. Whether apprenticed to a master or self-taught, you have made a name for yourself both for your unrivaled under- standing of terrain changes and your ability to represent them in beautiful maps.
